test_title: PYST 150: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 02 Feb, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Ken is sitting to the immediate right of Joe. Joe is sitting third to the left of Ben. Kat is sitting to the immediate right of Ben. Jen is the immediate neighbour of Ben and Ken. Who is the immediate neighbour of Ken and Mel?
solution:
1. Ken is sitting to the immediate right of Joe.

2. Jen is the immediate neighbour of Ben and Ken.

3. Kat is sitting to the immediate right of Ben.
